# telegram-bot-ui

> UI/UX for a Telegram bot's whole interface, kept current with the Bot API. Design, build and operate bots: texts, inline/reply keyboards, colored, disabled buttons, premium custom emoji, force_reply forms, navigation, streaming AI replies, Stop, private replies in groups, Rich Messages, HTML widgets, Mini Apps (Telegram.WebApp), TON wallet, topics, formatting, localization; whole products (shop with Stars, support, booking, onboarding, subscriptions, inline mode, business); channel posts (approve, publish once, edit, cross-post, mailings); an agent working via its own bot (notify, ask, approve, progress, hooks, MCP); offline lookup of every Bot API method and field, plus the server side. Use for 'improve this bot's menu', 'add a Stop button', 'post this to our channel', 'message me when the build is done', 'make a widget', 'build a Mini App', 'use premium emoji', 'can't parse entities', 'does the Bot API have X'. Do NOT use for webhook hosting, databases or auth unrelated to Telegram, or Microsoft .rtf files.

An Agent Skill in `skills/telegram-bot-ui/`. Start with its `SKILL.md`; open other files only when the task needs them. Paths are relative to the repository root. Capabilities:

- Build and audit bot interfaces: texts, inline and reply keyboards, colored and disabled buttons, navigation, forms, streaming AI replies with Stop, ephemeral replies in groups, Rich Messages, tables, formatting, localization.
- Product flows and use cases: shops, support, events, queues, AI assistants and 35 more families: find an example by intent; stale buttons, double submit, audience leaks.
- Publish to Telegram channels: compose, validate, preview, approve, schedule and publish channel posts without double posting.
- Operate as an agent through a bot: allowlisted operators, approval-bound actions, prompt injection in inbound messages, MCP bridge.
- Build HTML widgets: Bot API 10.4 widgets: size limit, production context, caption and text fallback, widget_query, shared widgets, TON wallet.
- Design, build and review Mini Apps: decide bot vs widget vs Mini App, launch points and startapp, Telegram.WebApp by version, a Telegram-native design system with named styles, components, layout rules for images, titles and prices, screen patterns, anti-slop lint, initData verification, mock preview.
- Use premium emoji packs: pick one custom emoji pack, resolve real ids, apply it to buttons, texts, rich messages and posts with all-or-nothing fallback; never invent an id.
- Look up the whole Bot API: methods, types and fields from a local catalog; validate a payload before sending; never invent a field.

## Entry point

- [Telegram Bot UI](skills/telegram-bot-ui/SKILL.md): Portable, SDK-agnostic skill for everything a Telegram bot shows and sends: bot screens, whole products, channel posts, HTML widgets,...

## Tools

- [audit_copy.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/audit_copy.py): Audit a localized message catalog for interface consistency. Offline.
- [audit_icons.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/audit_icons.py): Audit a bot's icon system: one consistent custom-emoji family per bot.
- [build_widget.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/build_widget.py): Build a Telegram HTML widget (Bot API 10.4) from a source file and the widget kit.
- [emoji_packs.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/emoji_packs.py): Premium (custom) emoji packs for a bot: resolve, suggest, verify, capture, apply, strip.
- [example_library.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/example_library.py): Find examples by user intent and validate the use-case catalog offline.
- [miniapp_layout.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/miniapp_layout.py): Layout rules for Mini App screens: recommend a layout for a content type, review a screen description.
- [miniapp_lint.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/miniapp_lint.py): Lint a Telegram Mini App's source for security mistakes, non-native patterns and AI-slop.
- [miniapp_style.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/miniapp_style.py): Mini App design styles: named presets and custom profiles compiled to kit-token overrides.
- [preview_miniapp.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/preview_miniapp.py): Local preview stand for a Telegram Mini App inside a MOCK of the Telegram client.
- [preview_widget.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/preview_widget.py): Local preview of a Telegram HTML widget inside a MOCK of the widget runtime.
- [style_profile.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/style_profile.py): Research a bot project's style and check the bot's style profile. Offline, stdlib only.
- [sync_bot_api.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/sync_bot_api.py): Snapshot the whole Telegram Bot API into data/bot-api/ and diff it.
- [tg_api_lookup.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/tg_api_lookup.py): Offline lookup over the Bot API snapshot in data/bot-api/.
- [tg_post.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/tg_post.py): Validate, preview and publish a Telegram channel post described in JSON or Markdown.
- [validate_keyboard.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/validate_keyboard.py): Validate Telegram button payloads: inline, reply and rich-message buttons.
- [validate_payload.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/validate_payload.py): Structural check of Bot API requests (and objects) against data/bot-api/.
- [validate_references.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/validate_references.py): Validate the skill's internal references and links.
- [validate_rich.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/validate_rich.py): Check an InputRichMessage (or a sendRichMessage / draft payload) offline.
- [validate_widget.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/validate_widget.py): Check an HTML widget before sendWidget (Bot API 10.4). Offline, no token.
- [webapp_lookup.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/webapp_lookup.py): Offline lookup over the Telegram.WebApp (Mini Apps client API) snapshot in data/mini-apps/.
- [widget_design.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/widget_design.py): Widget design profiles: a small JSON (`design.json`) that restyles any kit widget without
- [widget_lint.py](skills/telegram-bot-ui/scripts/widget_lint.py): Strict widget checks for the gallery and for widgets an agent writes (Bot API 10.4, profile 1).
